we have designed, implemented and evaluated a system that automatically generates MCQ tests using the semantic technologies and the Google Forms service, which can be used in different learning domains and for different types of tests.

(1) a service-oriented and semantics-based approach is a promising approach to generate online MCQ tests, (2) the proposed system can be applied to different domains and types of tests, and (3) the final version of test can be automatically published online.

(1) we have proposed a novel semantic service-based system that allows the automatic generation of MCQ tests for different learning domains, (2) we have proposed and evaluated a set of semantic heuristics for selecting the most suitable distractors and (3) the system has been implemented as a web-based service and has been evaluated using real-world data.

the automatic generation of MCQ tests that can be applied to different learning domains, and that can be easily adapted to different difficulty levels.
the automatic generation of MCQ tests for active learning, using semantic technologies and services.
the automatic generation of MCQ tests that are suitable for online learning.
